name: C&D Newin Paper & Pulp Corporation Limited
summary: Samson Paper Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding entity, primarily focused on the manufacturing and global distribution of a wide array of paper products. Its operations span key markets including Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, Singapore, and Korea, alongside broader international reach. The company's product portfolio encompasses printing, packaging, specialty, and copy papers, as well as waste paper. Founded in 1965, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Central, Hong Kong.
